android.desc:
Nomuk is an app designed to make practising basic arithmetic fun for your kids. This is targeted for children of age 4 - 12.

It is an ad-free, privacy rich app, that lets parents give the phone to their kids without worrying about distractions on phone. The app tracks every time, the child leaves the app or stops practising and sends a notification to the parents.

We follow a heirarchical course by course approach for children to improve fundamentals of basic / early math. You start with single digit addition. The app increases difficulty level of the problems presented as the child practices more and gets more answers correct in a row. Once the AI of the app is satisfied that the child has become comfortable in a particular course, it allows the child to move on to the next course. At each step, the parent is informed of the progress via whatsapp.

To get good at early math, there is no way but to solve as many problems as you can and as often as you can and Nomuk gives you a way, that your children would like working on. You have the option to go back to any of the previous courses, if you want to repeat practising or for revision before exams.

Why do we charge? We do not show ads, nor collect your data. We also have costs from Whatsapp to keep you notified of your child’s progress. We charge so that we can be a clean, efficient platform and so that we can keep building more courses in for your child.
